hero.title: ECHO
hero.subtitle: Private Messages.
hero.description: Military-grade end-to-end encryption for everyone. No backdoors. No exceptions.

features.title: Privacy by Design
features.description: Every feature engineered with your fundamental right to privacy
features.echoProtocolDetails: Our custom implementation of the Extended Triple Diffie-Hellman key agreement protocol ensures that your messages are encrypted before they even leave your device. We use AES-256-GCM for the highest level of security.
features.zeroKnowledgeDesc: We never see your data. Privacy by design.
features.zeroKnowledgeDetails: Our architecture is built so that we cannot access your private keys or messages.
features.forwardSecrecyDesc: Dynamic key rotation protects past chats.
features.forwardSecrecyDetails: If a key is ever compromised, it cannot be used to decrypt past messages.
features.ephemeralDetails: Configure messages to self-destruct after a set period.
features.groupChatsDetails: Group chats are encrypted using the Sender Keys protocol.
features.decentralizedDesc: No central servers. You control your data.
features.decentralizedDetails: Optional peer-to-peer architecture that eliminates single points of failure and ensures your communications don't depend on any central entity.
features.openSourceDetails: Our entire codebase is open source and available for audit.
